dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: Anyone who wants %s comes through me.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Ya gotta get past me for %s!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: I kept your back for years, %s. Not any more.
This is for every order you ever barked at me, %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: I guard ya back long time, %s. No more.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Surprise, %s! I'm not yours no more!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: You never knew whose side I was on, %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Long time I wait for dis, %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: So you saw through it, %s. No matter.
Did you sleep well here, %s? You won't again.
I've lived next door to you all this time, %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Ya sleep good here, %s? Not no more.
I live next to ya all dis time, %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Boo, %s! I been here da whole time!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: It wasn't me! I swear it wasn't me!
Someone did this to me! Listen to me!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Not me! I no do it!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: Leave it to me, %1$s. In %2$s I'm one of them again, and I'll be your ears.
%2$s won't know I'm yours, %1$s. Not until you need me.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: I go back to %2$s, %1$s. Dey think I theirs. I yours.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Back to %2$s for me, %1$s! Dey won't suspect nothin'!
I'll be ya ears in %2$s, %1$s! Hehe!

news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.plant.struck: %1$s of %2$s was living in town under another name, and struck at %3$s in the night.
